title: Open Quadruped

assemblySteps.title: Build the chassis and tray
assemblySteps.summary: Seat the rails and shoulder frames in the lower shell. Fit the electronics tray between the rails.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the front left leg
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hip at the shoulder and fit the two links and foot.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the front right leg
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hip at the shoulder and fit the two links and foot.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the rear left leg
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hip at the shoulder and fit the two links and foot.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the rear right leg
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hip at the shoulder and fit the two links and foot.

assemblySteps.title: Fit the servo hub and battery
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hub above the tray, then seat the 3S holder against the right rail and secure it with a strap clamp.

assemblySteps.title: Connect power and servo leads
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the battery to the hub, then plug in the front and rear PWM leads.
